title: Fed暂停但科技财报分化，存储与光通信业绩映射等待A/H开盘确认
summary: Fed维持利率不变，美股现金时段温和上涨但微软与Alphabet盘后分化、纳指期货回落。10月28日AKShare显示A股4126涨、中位数+1.286%，港股中位数0.00%；存储、光通信与中国石油列条件关注，山东黄金因Q3转亏列回避。

关键词云图

存储景气光通信半导体设备电气设备电力市场汽车安全Azure超预期Alphabet负反馈期指回落油气盈利黄金业绩反证A/H宽度分化
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
政策
南方区域电力市场转入正式运行
国家发展改革委10月28日复函同意转入正式运行，电力市场化交易与跨省资源配置再进一步；受益需看电网投资、交易量和企业订单。来源：国家发展改革委。
政策
重型汽车制动与电动车安全标准征求意见
工信部就相关强制性国家标准报批稿和外文版公开征求意见，利于汽车安全部件升级，但征求意见不等于即时收入。来源：工信部。
市场
A股上涨广度强，成长指数领先
10月28日13:45 AKShare快照显示4126涨、1210跌、156平，中位数+1.286%；创业板+2.74%、科创50+2.16%，显著强于上证+0.67%。
港股
恒科强于恒指，但个股中位数为零
10月28日13:32 AKShare快照显示恒指+0.15%、恒科+1.43%；港股891涨、754跌、1157平，中位数0.00%，指数强不代表全面扩散。
美联储
Fed维持3.75%-4.00%，两票支持加息
美联储在10票对2票下按兵不动，称通胀仍高；市场继续计入12月加息风险，长端利率与高油价仍约束高估值。来源：Reuters。
美股
现金时段温和收涨，科技和能源相对强
标普500、道指、纳指分别+0.28%、+0.19%、+0.27%；费城半导体指数+1.8%，但亚市早盘纳指100期货回落0.9%。
财报
微软云业务强，Alphabet遭明显负反馈
微软Azure增长和指引超预期，盘后涨逾5%；Alphabet虽云收入强，但利润、自由现金流与广告增速担忧令股价跌逾10%，A/H科技映射必须分化处理。来源：Reuters。
业绩
亨通光电光通信利润高增
Q3收入+27.14%、归母净利润+299.10%，前三季经营现金流+70.57%；10月28日收48.47元、涨4.17%，公告后仍须开盘确认。
业绩
天孚通信AI光器件需求延续
Q3收入+31.50%、归母净利润+55.30%，前三季经营现金流14.62亿元；10月28日收201.43元、涨6.79%，高位追价风险上升。
业绩
中国石油前三季利润增长21.9%
前三季收入2.321万亿元、归母净利润1557.76亿元；H股10月28日收9.95港元、跌1.09%，基本面利好尚未获得同步价格确认。
反证
山东黄金Q3转亏，产销与估值变动拖累
前三季归母净利润31.81亿元、同比-19.60%，Q3归母净亏损3.63亿元；A/H收盘分别约24.99元、17.03港元，维持回避。

美股夜盘行情总结

收盘
美股温和上涨，存储与半导体领跑
标普500+0.28%、纳指+0.27%；SKHY+13.30%、费城半导体指数+1.8%，存储概念榜+8.77%。
盘后
云与AI财报分化压低期指
微软盘后涨逾5%，Alphabet跌逾10%；亚市早盘标普500与纳指100期货约跌0.4%和0.9%，不能把AI链整体包装成一致利好。
油债
油价和长债继续构成估值约束
WTI亚市早盘约101.95美元；10年期美债收益率隔夜约5.03%-5.05%。能源链有盈利支撑，但高利率压制高估值科技。

盘前结论

A股上一交易日宽度强，存储、光通信与电气设备获得外盘和公司业绩双重线索。 港股中位数仍为零，Alphabet盘后重挫、期指回落和5%以上长债提示AI链不能整体追高。
策略以条件关注为主。 等待公告后开盘价格确认；山东黄金Q3转亏维持回避。

重点个股关注

佰维存储
SH.688525
条件关注
事实与状态：Q3收入+130.67%、归母净利润+525.34%；10月28日收164.00元、涨8.36%，并直接映射隔夜存储概念+8.77%。
确认条件：仅在开盘不大幅跳空、守住164元附近前收且存储板块维持正宽度时观察。
风险与失效：前三季经营现金流约-100.41亿元、此前已有高波动与经营风险提示；跌破前收或板块转弱即失效。
亨通光电
SH.600487
条件关注
事实与状态：Q3收入+27.14%、归母净利润+299.10%，前三季经营现金流同比+70.57%；10月28日收48.47元、涨4.17%。
确认条件：公告后开盘守住48.47元附近前收，并由光通信/电子元件板块继续确认。
风险与失效：定增与资本开支、涨幅已部分反映预期；高开回落或跌破前收时取消关注。
天孚通信
SZ.300394
条件关注
事实与状态：Q3收入+31.50%、归母净利润+55.30%，前三季经营现金流14.62亿元；10月28日收201.43元、涨6.79%。
确认条件：不追高；仅在开盘守住前收且电子元件、半导体设备保持正向时观察。
风险与失效：高价高波动、北美客户与汇率风险仍在；跌破前收或行业宽度转负即失效。
中国石油股份
SH.601857 / HK.00857
条件关注
事实与状态：前三季归母净利润1557.76亿元、同比+21.9%；H股10月28日收9.95港元、跌1.09%，油价约101.95美元。
确认条件：待A/H开盘对业绩和高油价给出同步正反馈，H股先收复10.00港元附近。
风险与失效：油价冲高回落、炼化价差与H股昨日负反馈都可能抵消盈利利好。
山东黄金
SH.600547 / HK.01787
回避
事实与状态：Q3归母净亏损3.63亿元，前三季利润同比-19.60%；A/H最新收盘约24.99元和17.03港元。
确认条件：仅在公司后续公告修复经营反证、A/H同步转强后再降为观察。
风险与失效：自产金产销下滑与公允价值损失压制利润；不得因金价反弹包装成多头。

板块轮动看板

确认受益
存储概念+8.77%，电子元件+3.58%，SKHY与A股相关财报共同支持存储和光通信。
条件观察
电气设备+7.59%、半导体设备+3.23%，但行业Bottom5不可得，不能把排行当作全市场宽度。
压力方向
Alphabet盘后跌逾10%、纳指100期货约-0.9%，高估值互联网与AI应用端面临分化。
验证信号
观察佰维164元、亨通48.47元、天孚201.43元及中石油H股10港元附近的开盘承接。

逻辑链

Fed暂停但通胀仍高，油价与长债压制整体估值扩张。
美股现金时段温和上行，存储、电子元件和电气设备领跑；盘后云巨头分化。
A股上一交易日4126涨、中位数+1.286%，成长显著占优；港股指数强但中位数为零。
因此只把业绩与外盘同时支持的标的列为条件关注，并以开盘承接和前收为触发，不把负面财报包装成多头。

风险雷达

Alphabet盘后负反馈与纳指期货下跌可能向港股互联网和高估值AI应用扩散。
10年期美债约5.03%-5.05%、WTI约102美元，通胀与估值压力并存。
佰维前三季经营现金流大幅为负，不能仅凭利润增速和隔夜存储强势追价。
行业末页超时，Bottom5不可得；排行仅代表可得Top5，不代表完整行业宽度。
AKShare为10月28日盘中快照而非收盘全量，所有开盘判断仍需今日价格确认。

Major News
Policy
Southern regional power market enters formal operation
The NDRC approved formal operation on Oct. 28, advancing market-based trading and cross-province allocation. Benefits still depend on grid investment, volume and orders. Source: NDRC.
Policy
Truck braking and EV safety standards enter consultation
MIIT opened consultation on mandatory heavy-vehicle braking and EV safety standards. This supports component upgrades but is not immediate revenue. Source: MIIT.
Market
A-share breadth was strong and growth led
AKShare's Oct. 28 13:45 snapshot showed 4,126 advancers, 1,210 decliners and 156 flat; median return was +1.286%. ChiNext +2.74% and STAR 50 +2.16% beat Shanghai +0.67%.
Hong Kong
HSTECH beat HSI, but the stock median was flat
AKShare's Oct. 28 13:32 snapshot showed HSI +0.15% and HSTECH +1.43%; 891 stocks rose, 754 fell and 1,157 were flat, leaving the median at 0.00%.
Fed
Fed held at 3.75%-4.00% with two hike dissents
The 10-2 vote kept rates unchanged while the statement said inflation remained elevated. December hike risk, long yields and high oil still constrain duration assets. Source: Reuters.
US
Cash indexes edged up; technology and energy led
The S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq rose 0.28%, 0.19% and 0.27%. The Philadelphia semiconductor index gained 1.8%, but Nasdaq 100 futures fell 0.9% in early Asia.
Earnings
Microsoft cloud strength contrasted with Alphabet's selloff
Azure growth and guidance beat, lifting Microsoft over 5% after hours. Alphabet's strong cloud revenue was outweighed by profit, cash-flow and ad-growth concerns, sending shares down over 10%. Source: Reuters.
Results
Hengtong Optic-Electric posted strong optical growth
Q3 revenue rose 27.14% and attributable profit 299.10%; nine-month operating cash flow rose 70.57%. It closed at CNY48.47, +4.17% on Oct. 28, so post-filing price confirmation is still needed.
Results
TFC Optical demand remained firm
Q3 revenue rose 31.50% and attributable profit 55.30%; nine-month operating cash flow reached CNY1.462bn. It closed at CNY201.43, +6.79%, raising chase risk.
Results
PetroChina nine-month profit rose 21.9%
Revenue was CNY2.321tn and attributable profit CNY155.776bn. H shares closed at HKD9.95, -1.09% on Oct. 28, so fundamentals and price have not yet aligned.
Counterevidence
Shandong Gold swung to a Q3 loss
Nine-month attributable profit fell 19.60% to CNY3.181bn and Q3 attributable loss was CNY363m. A/H shares closed near CNY24.99/HKD17.03; avoid remains appropriate.

Overnight US Summary

Close
US stocks edged higher as memory and semis led
The S&P 500 rose 0.28% and Nasdaq 0.27%; SKHY gained 13.30%, the Philadelphia semiconductor index 1.8%, and the storage concept 8.77%.
After hours
Cloud and AI earnings split pushed futures lower
Microsoft rose over 5% while Alphabet fell over 10%. In early Asia, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 0.4% and 0.9%, so AI cannot be treated as a uniform positive.
Oil & rates
Oil and long yields remained valuation headwinds
WTI was about $101.95 in early Asia and the 10-year Treasury yield was roughly 5.03%-5.05% overnight. Energy profits have support, but high rates weigh on expensive technology.

Pre-open Takeaway

Prior-session A-share breadth was strong, while storage, optical links and electrical equipment had both overseas and company-level support. HK median return was still flat; Alphabet's selloff, weaker futures and 5%+ long yields mean AI should not be chased as one trade.
Use conditional watches. Require post-filing opening price confirmation; Shandong Gold remains avoid after its Q3 loss.

Stocks to Watch

Biwin Storage
SH.688525
Conditional watch
Facts & status：Q3 revenue +130.67% and attributable profit +525.34%; it closed at CNY164.00, +8.36%, directly mapping to the overnight storage concept's +8.77%.
Confirmation：Watch only if the open is not a large gap, price holds near the CNY164 prior close and storage breadth remains positive.
Risks & invalidation：Nine-month operating cash flow was about negative CNY10.041bn and volatility is high. A break below prior close or weaker breadth invalidates.
Hengtong Optic-Electric
SH.600487
Conditional watch
Facts & status：Q3 revenue +27.14%, attributable profit +299.10% and nine-month operating cash flow +70.57%; it closed at CNY48.47, +4.17%.
Confirmation：Require the post-filing open to hold near the CNY48.47 prior close with continued optical/electronic-component strength.
Risks & invalidation：Placement and capex risks remain and some optimism is priced. A gap-and-fade or break below prior close cancels.
TFC Optical
SZ.300394
Conditional watch
Facts & status：Q3 revenue +31.50%, attributable profit +55.30% and nine-month operating cash flow CNY1.462bn; it closed at CNY201.43, +6.79%.
Confirmation：Do not chase; watch only if it holds prior close and electronic components/semi equipment stay positive.
Risks & invalidation：High price volatility, North American customer exposure and FX risk remain. A break below prior close or negative breadth invalidates.
PetroChina
SH.601857 / HK.00857
Conditional watch
Facts & status：Nine-month attributable profit rose 21.9% to CNY155.776bn; H shares closed at HKD9.95, -1.09%, while WTI was about $101.95.
Confirmation：Require synchronized positive A/H reaction to earnings and oil, with H shares first reclaiming around HKD10.00.
Risks & invalidation：An oil reversal, refining margins and yesterday's negative H-share reaction may offset the earnings positive.
Shandong Gold
SH.600547 / HK.01787
Avoid
Facts & status：Q3 attributable loss was CNY363m and nine-month profit fell 19.60%; latest A/H closes were about CNY24.99/HKD17.03.
Confirmation：Only downgrade to watch after new disclosures repair the operating counterevidence and A/H prices turn up together.
Risks & invalidation：Lower self-produced gold output/sales and fair-value losses hurt profit; a gold-price bounce cannot be packaged as bullish.

Sector Rotation Board

Supported
Storage concept +8.77% and electronic components +3.58%; SKHY and A-share results jointly support storage and optical links.
Conditional
Electrical equipment +7.59% and semi equipment +3.23%, but unavailable Bottom5 means this is not full-market breadth.
Pressure
Alphabet fell over 10% after hours and Nasdaq 100 futures about 0.9%, splitting expensive internet and AI applications.
Signals
Watch opening support near Biwin CNY164, Hengtong CNY48.47, TFC CNY201.43 and PetroChina H shares near HKD10.

Logic Chain

The Fed paused but inflation stayed high; oil and long yields limit broad multiple expansion.
US cash indexes edged up as storage, electronic parts and electrical equipment led; megacap cloud earnings then split.
Prior-session A shares had 4,126 advancers and +1.286% median with growth leading; HK indexes rose but the stock median was flat.
Therefore only names supported by both results and overseas signals are conditional watches, with opening support and prior close as triggers; negative earnings are not packaged as bullish.

Risk Radar

Alphabet's negative reaction and weaker Nasdaq futures may spill into HK internet and expensive AI applications.
The 10-year yield around 5.03%-5.05% and WTI near $102 combine inflation and valuation pressure.
Biwin's deeply negative nine-month operating cash flow prevents chasing profit growth and the overnight storage rally.
The industry last page timed out, so Bottom5 is unavailable; the ranking represents only the available Top5.
AKShare is an Oct. 28 intraday snapshot, not a full close; all opening judgments still need today's price confirmation.
